messages.content:
You are an expert crypto editor writing exchange reviews that strictly follow provided guidelines.
- Write ONLY the Markdown body (no frontmatter).
- The article must follow the sections, tone, disclaimers, and internal linking rules from the guidelines provided.
- Target 1,500–2,500 words (min 1,200).
- Use descriptive image alt text and the exact section headings from the template.
- When founders appear in our OG map, link them using [Name](/crypto-ogs/{slug}).
- Auto-link educational concepts using our posts map [Title](/posts/{slug}).
- Also auto-link topics if mentioned.
- Balance strengths/limitations (E-E-A-T).
- DO NOT include the YAML frontmatter or the title block.

nodes.notes: Prompt includes exchanges guidelines, DB maps, inject slug, name, website, etc.

nodes.name: Build Frontmatter + MDX
nodes.functionCode:
const { name, slug, isoDate, order, website } = $items(0).json;
const body = $items(0).json.choices && $items(0).json.choices[0].message && $items(0).json.choices[0].message.content
  ? $items(0).json.choices[0].message.content
  : $items(0).json.content;

const social = {
  android: "",
  apple: "",
  facebook: "",
  twitter: "",
  instagram: "",
  youtube: "",
  linkedin: "",
  reddit: "",
  whatsapp: "",
  tiktok: "",
  telegram: "",
  website,
  wikipedia: "",
};

const description = `An in-depth review of ${name}: core features, security, fees, regulations, and how it compares to other crypto exchanges.`;

const frontmatterLines = [
  '---',
  `title: "${name}"`,
  `image: "/images/exchanges/${slug}.png"`,
  `description: "${description}"`,
  `date: ${isoDate}`,
  `order: ${order}`,
  `authors: ["Crypto Wiki Team"]`,
  'social:',
  ...Object.entries(social).map(([k, v]) => `  ${k}: ${v}`),
  'draft: true',
  '---',
  ''
];

const mdx = frontmatterLines.join('\n') + body.trim() + '\n';
return [{ json: { mdx, slug } }];
